title: 第13章 你去死吧！
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
夜幕降临，华灯初上。

    苏牧回到七号院，一进院子便见自己门口站着一人，背靠墙壁双手抱胸，双目微合似在小憩。

    来者却是王充，二十七岁，三灵根炼气六层修为，在熟人小范围圈子里被称为‘闭关狂人’。

    苏牧走上前去开门，随口问到：“等了很久？”

    王充睁开双眼，没有回话，跟着进了屋，径直到桌前坐下，面无表情道：“恭喜，借钱。”

    苏牧好笑道：“这个月一半都没过完，资源就用完了？要多少？”

    王充默了下道：“准备突破，越多越好。”

    苏牧心中一动，微微颔首，在桌子底下从储物袋里分装出一袋灵石放在他面前，说道：“三十块，只能拿出这么多。”

    王充伸手抄起布袋，起身道：“我能突破，贺礼抵消。”

    说完便转身迈步离去。

    苏牧哑然，关了门，进去修炼室。

    他取出【凤血黑晶玉】手链，心念一动，直接收进识海坟陵，随即盘膝坐好，开始修炼。

    五天一晃而过。

    经过一番仔细验证，苏牧心中大喜，摩挲着珠链爱不释手，不禁赞叹：“简直是异宝！”

    怀揣手链沉入修行，体内气血异常活跃，元气运行比以前顺畅得多，修炼速度起码能快两成。

    而手链对神识的助益效果，更是堪比神物，能使人大脑清明，迅速进入专注状态，不被外物分神。

    此前，他持续打坐修炼只能坚持六七个时辰，便会神识疲累，需要休息。

    如今有了手链辅助，能一次性修炼三十五个时辰，才会出现一丝困倦之感。

    而且恢复起来也快，从前修炼完得休息两三个时辰才能缓解疲劳。

    现在停下修炼，戴着手链只需要一炷多香的时间，疲惫感顿消，恢复到正常状态。

    “看来，今年是我的气运年啊……”

    “先是金手指激活，识海多了一片神异莫测的坟陵，可转化能量提升修为。”

    “眼下又有了这珠链，可加快修炼速度，凭空多出来许多修炼时间。”

    “还有齐长老一辈子的积蓄，数目肯定不小。”

    “若无意外，最迟明年底，我应该就能突破至炼气七层！”

    苏牧嘴角勾起笑意，内心振奋，信心十足。

    此前识海坟陵显露，他还曾忧虑，以自己五灵根低劣资质，修为停滞十五年之久，若是突然短期内连续突破，必惹人起疑。

    与齐云溪成亲却是可以解决这个问题，让修为进步变得合理。

    至于成亲可能带来的麻烦……

    从备下三枚筑基丹可见，齐子濯显然也是经过深思熟虑，反复权衡后最终做出的选择，定会做好妥善安排，问题应该不大。

    少顷，苏牧收了思绪，出了屋去。

    在院子里散步与其他弟子闲聊了一炷香，他又返回房间，准备继续修炼。

    刚盘膝坐下，外面响起了敲门声。

    苏牧出到客厅将门打开，怔了一瞬，随即拱手施礼叫了声‘沈师姐’，然后侧身摆手作请。
content_en:
As night falls, the lanterns come on.

    Su Mu returned to Courtyard No. 7. As soon as he entered the courtyard, he saw a person standing at his door, leaning against the wall with his hands folded and his eyes slightly closed as if he was taking a nap.

    The person who came was Wang Chong, who was twenty-seven years old and had the sixth level of Qi Refining with Three Spiritual Roots. He was known as a 'reclusive madman' in a small circle of acquaintances.

    Su Mu stepped forward to open the door and asked casually: "Have you been waiting for a long time?"

    Wang Chong opened his eyes, did not reply, followed into the room, sat down at the table, and said expressionlessly: "Congratulations, borrow money."

    Su Mu said with a smile: "Half of this month has not passed, and the resources have been used up? How much do you need?"

    Wang Chong was silent for a moment and said: "Be prepared to break through, the more, the better."

    Su Mu's heart moved, he nodded slightly, took out a bag of spirit stones from the storage bag under the table, put it in front of him, and said, "Thirty yuan, you can only take out so much."

    Wang Chong reached out to pick up the cloth bag, stood up and said, "I can break through, and the gifts can offset it."

    After saying that, he turned around and walked away.

    Su Mu was dumbfounded, closed the door, and entered the practice room.

    He took out the [Phoenix Blood Black Crystal Jade] bracelet, and with a thought, put it directly into the Tomb of the Sea of ​​​​Consciousness, then sat cross-legged and began to practice.

    Five days flew by.

    After careful verification, Su Mu was overjoyed. He fondled the bead chain and couldn't put it down. He couldn't help but admire: "It's a rare treasure!"

    When I practice with the bracelet in my arms, the qi and blood in my body are extremely active, the vitality runs much smoother than before, and my cultivation speed can be at least 20% faster.

    The bracelet's beneficial effect on spiritual consciousness is comparable to that of a divine object. It can make people's brains clear, quickly enter a state of concentration, and not be distracted by external objects.

    Previously, he could only continue to meditate for six or seven hours before his consciousness became tired and he needed to rest.

    Now with the help of the bracelet, I can practice for thirty-five hours at a time before I feel a trace of sleepiness.

    And he recovers quickly. In the past, he had to rest for two or three hours after practicing to relieve fatigue.

    Now that I stop practicing and wear the bracelet for just one stick of incense, my fatigue will disappear and I will return to my normal state.

    "It seems that this year is my lucky year..."

    "First, the golden finger is activated. A mysterious tomb is added to the sea of ​​consciousness, which can transform energy and improve cultivation."

    "Now that I have this bead chain, I can speed up my practice and get a lot more practice time out of thin air."

    "There is also Elder Qi's life savings, which must be quite a lot."

    "If nothing unexpected happens, I should be able to break through to the seventh level of Qi Refining by the end of next year at the latest!"

    A smile appeared on Su Mu's lips, feeling excited and confident.

    Before the knowledge sea tomb was revealed, he had been worried that due to his poor qualifications in the Five Spiritual Roots, his cultivation had been stagnant for fifteen years. If he suddenly made continuous breakthroughs in a short period of time, it would arouse suspicion.

    Marrying Qi Yunxi can solve this problem and make progress in cultivation reasonable.

    As for the troubles that may come with getting married...

    It can be seen from the preparation of three foundation-building pills that Qi Zizuo made the final choice after careful consideration and repeated weighing. He will definitely make proper arrangements and there should be no big problem.

    After a while, Su Mu put his thoughts away and went out of the house.

    After walking in the yard and chatting with other disciples for a moment, he returned to his room and prepared to continue practicing.

    Just as he sat down cross-legged, there was a knock on the door outside.

    Su Mu went out to the living room and opened the door. He was stunned for a moment, then he bowed his hands and called "Senior Sister Shen", then turned sideways and waved in greeting.
